name: Don Weber
occupation: North Plains City Councilor (per pamphlet); retired director of a Big Brothers Big Sisters program

bio.statement: Weber's pamphlet statement lists his occupation as North Plains City Councilor and his background as retired director of a Big Brothers Big Sisters program.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: North Plains City Councilor Occupational Background: Retired Director: a Big Brother and Big Sisters program

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)

bio.statement: The pamphlet lists his prior governmental experience as the North Plains Re-Look Committee and the North Plains Parks and Recreation Board.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: North Plains Re-Look Committee North Plains Parks & Recreation Board

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)

bio.statement: Weber says in his pamphlet statement that his background is in finance and that fiscal responsibility is important to him.
bio.excerpt: My background is in finance, so fiscal responsibility is important for me.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)

positions.statement: Weber's pamphlet statement supports smart growth and opposes expanding the city by over 500 acres with most of the land for industrial growth.
positions.excerpt: I support smart growth-- not expanding our city by over 500 acres with a majority of that land for industrial growth.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement supports improving infrastructure for safety and efficiency and using the Urban Renewal Agency to serve local businesses, especially on main street.
positions.excerpt: I support improving city infrastructure for safety and efficiency, and using our Urban Renewal Agency to better serve local businesses, especially on main street.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement says he has advocated for North Plains to complete past-due audits and will complete this task if elected.
positions.excerpt: I have advocated for North Plains to complete past due audits, and will complete this task if elected.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement says he will convene residents to hear from experts on growth issues.
positions.excerpt: I will convene residents to hear from experts (not developers and land speculators) on growth issues.

source.publisher: Washington County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov. 3, 2026 (page WC-23)
